profile.name: BHUPENDRA KUMAR
profile.summary: Senior-level Backend Developer with 2.5+ years of hands-on experience engineering scalable, distributed systems and cloud-native applications. Specializes in building high-performance REST APIs and real-time data processing pipelines utilizing Python, FastAPI, and Kafka. Proven track record in orchestrating containerized deployments via Kubernetes and Docker, optimizing database operations, and architecting fault-tolerant microservices. Passionate about AI/ML integrations and driving end-to-end feature delivery through robust CI/CD workﬂows.

educations.school: Indian Institute of Information Technology Surat
Indian Institute of Information Technology Surat

descriptions: Designed and maintained highly scalable, production-grade backend systems using Python and FastAPI, serving over 50,000 daily active requests.
Architected a distributed, event-driven microservices ecosystem utilizing Kafka and Rabbit MQ, ensuring fault tolerance and high-throughput real-time data processing.
Optimized application performance and complex SQL operations; implemented Redis caching layers that reduced average database query load times by 45%.
Integrated backend services with AWS cloud infrastructure (EC2, S3, RDS) and managed containerized application deployments using Docker and Kubernetes orchestration.
Spearheaded the implementation of automated CI/CD deployment workﬂows using Git Hub Actions and Jenkins, cutting deployment friction and improving system reliability.

workExperiences.company: Google Developer Group Lead (Promoted from Core Member)
descriptions: Collaborate directly with cross-functional teams (frontend, Dev Ops) to lead 15 developers in building a highly scalable, full-stack event management platform.
Built secure REST APIs using Django and Flask, enforcing strict authentication, authorization, and backend security best practices (OWASP standards).
Organized and led large-scale technical events, including the ”Prompt Craft” and ”Reimagination Hackathon”, mentoring students in system design and backend architecture.
Developed an AI/ML-integrated backend system capable of conducting mock technical interviews and generating real-time, context-aware evaluations.
Engineered secure, low-latency RESTful APIs using FastAPI to communicate with LLM endpoints, processing candidate responses with high efﬁciency.
Utilized Mongo DB to structure and store large volumes of historical user session data and performance metrics for ongoing model reﬁnement and analytics.
Built a resilient, distributed key-value store from scratch, successfully handling 15,000+ requests per second while maintaining 99.99% uptime.
Implemented the RAFT leader election protocol to guarantee strong consistency and fault tolerance across distributed nodes.
Applied advanced concurrency concepts and memory optimization techniques, outperforming baseline Redis write performance benchmarks by 25%.
